FAA Headquarters or the Directors of Terminal or En Route and Oceanic Area Operations (or their designee) having jurisdiction over the area concerned.

  • Restrictions are kept to the minimum area and duration necessary that will address the situation.
  • Any NOTAM that implements a TFR should specify the reason for the flight restriction.

    • Note: TFRs are only implemented for sovereign U.S. airspace and its territories.

    The FAA may issue an advisory of any hazard/danger outside U.S. airspace via the NOTAM System.
